title: Feeling Different Today?
caption: Ordinary signal mix today—small steady choices do the work. — Kp 1.7 • Bz -4.8 nT • Schumann 7.78 Hz (snapshot at write time)
snapshot:
Space Weather Snapshot
Signals are sitting in a fairly ordinary range today. Small steady choices matter most. Drivers: recent CME after-effects, fresh flare activity, southward field orientation. Schumann resonance has been lively enough to notice for some sensitive systems. Keep a steady rhythm and make regulation easier than recovery.
affects:
- Focus/energy: Steadier conditions make longer focus stretches easier to use.
- Autonomic/HRV: A quieter field can make recovery work feel more cooperative.
- Sleep: Keep evening light warm and low so the calmer rhythm carries through.
- Pattern note: Gaia Eyes often sees steadier recovery patterns on days like this.
playbook:
- Use the steadier stretch for one or two focused tasks
- Keep light movement and natural light in the day to reinforce rhythm
- Hydrate and keep caffeine earlier so sleep stays easier later
